title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 10 — WORLD 7: C2 ACADEMIC MASTERY, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERT COMMUNICATION
grammar: Advanced clause combining for precise relationships between evidence, interpretation, qualification, and conclusion
Tense and aspect choices in academic narration, explanation, reporting, and historical analysis
Complex modality and stance for probability, limitation, evaluation, and responsible academic claims
Relative, participial, appositive, and supplementary structures for dense but controlled information
Cohesive devices, discourse markers, lexical repetition, and reference across extended texts
Nominalisation and grammatical metaphor for formal analytical and research communication
Hedging, boosting, attribution, and citation language for nuanced knowledge claims
Register and audience adaptation between specialist, academic, educational, and public communication

missions.title: Academic Mastery Gateway
missions.focus: Identify the language patterns needed to understand and communicate sophisticated academic and expert ideas.

missions.title: Knowledge Vocabulary Forge
missions.focus: Master high-precision vocabulary and collocations for research, scholarship, expertise, and intellectual debate.

missions.title: Complex Text Observatory
missions.focus: Navigate demanding texts by identifying thesis, structure, assumptions, evidence, implications, and limitations.

missions.title: Claim & Evidence Reactor
missions.focus: Separate claims from evidence and evaluate whether conclusions are adequately supported by the information provided.

missions.title: Expert Lecture Listening Lab
missions.focus: Track dense spoken explanations, examples, qualifications, transitions, and conclusions in expert-level audio.

missions.title: Academic Stance Chamber
missions.focus: Express agreement, uncertainty, criticism, significance, and interpretation with carefully calibrated academic language.

missions.title: Source Integration Portal
missions.focus: Integrate ideas from several sources through accurate paraphrase, synthesis, attribution, and comparison.

missions.title: Theory Comparison Arena
missions.focus: Compare competing explanations by defining concepts, identifying assumptions, and weighing explanatory strengths and limits.

missions.title: Research Methodology Nexus
missions.focus: Understand and explain research design, variables, limitations, sampling, interpretation, and methodological choices.

missions.title: Critical Literature Review Engine
missions.focus: Synthesize a set of readings into a coherent critical review that identifies patterns, disagreements, and gaps.

missions.title: Expert Interview Simulator
missions.focus: Conduct a sophisticated interview by asking precise questions, clarifying technical answers, and following emerging ideas.

missions.title: Public Knowledge Translation Lab
missions.focus: Translate specialist knowledge into clear language for an informed non-specialist audience without losing accuracy.

missions.title: Academic Debate Observatory
missions.focus: Build and defend a nuanced position while accurately representing alternative interpretations and responding to objections.

missions.title: Concept Definition Studio
missions.focus: Define abstract concepts precisely, distinguish related terms, and illustrate meaning through relevant examples.

missions.title: Evidence-Based Essay Forge
missions.focus: Write an extended analytical essay with a controlled thesis, integrated evidence, counterargument, and qualified conclusion.

missions.title: Research Poster Presentation
missions.focus: Condense a complex investigation into a clear visual-style spoken presentation with logical sequencing and concise explanation.

missions.title: Peer Review Challenge
missions.focus: Evaluate another argument constructively by identifying strengths, weaknesses, unsupported claims, and specific improvements.

missions.title: Expert Q&A Command
missions.focus: Respond spontaneously to demanding questions by clarifying assumptions, qualifying claims, and reasoning aloud precisely.

missions.title: Integrated Knowledge Quest
missions.focus: Combine reading, listening, research synthesis, writing, grammar, vocabulary, and speaking in a complete academic scenario.

missions.title: C2 Academic Mastery Challenge
missions.focus: Complete an expert communication challenge demonstrating precise, evidence-aware, flexible, and audience-conscious C2 English.

realWorldScenarios.title: Research Symposium
realWorldScenarios.description: Present a complex investigation to an expert audience, explain methodology and evidence, address limitations, and answer critical questions.

realWorldScenarios.title: Knowledge Translation Mission
realWorldScenarios.description: Convert specialist research into an accessible briefing for decision-makers and the public while preserving essential nuance.

realWorldScenarios.title: Peer Review Council
realWorldScenarios.description: Evaluate competing academic arguments, identify evidence gaps, propose revisions, and defend your analysis in discussion.

assessment.type: Integrated C2 academic mastery and expert communication assessment
successCriteria: precise and flexible C2 academic language control
clear distinction between evidence and inference
effective use of advanced grammar and cohesion
nuanced stance, hedging, attribution, and qualification
clear adaptation from specialist to public-facing communication
confident and precise responses to expert questions
